terminals.name: Cebu South Bus Terminal (CSBT)
terminals.address: N. Bacalso Avenue, Cebu City (between the LTO-7 office and CityMall Bacalso)
terminals.notes: Run by the Cebu Provincial Government. A single combined north–south terminal has been discussed; confirm the current site before travelling.

terminals.name: Cebu North Bus Terminal (CNBT)
terminals.address: SM City Cebu outdoor parking area, corner S. Osmeña Road and Kaohsiung Street, North Reclamation Area, Cebu City
terminals.notes: Temporary site agreed with SM Prime in 2020 and still in use per late-2025 reports. Peak-season satellite loading points have been used (for example near U.N. Ave. and Marcelo Fernan Bridge, Mandaue); check announcements.

terminals.name: Parkmall Terminal (Mandaue)
terminals.address: Parkmall, Ouano Avenue, Mandaue Reclamation Area, Mandaue City
terminals.notes: Large mall terminal mainly served by modern jeepneys (including codes 24 and 25); MyBus buses also stop here.

routes.notes: Endpoints and stops agree across an OSM community listing and Wikivoyage. Stops and schedules change; confirm at the terminal. SM Seaside end point is a rough estimate.
Endpoints agree across an OSM community listing and Wikivoyage. Roads are not confirmed; the line is a rough guide along the south coast.

Endpoints agree across Wikivoyage, travel guides and a 2026 transport guide; an OSM listing extends this code to SM Seaside City. One guide estimates 35–40 minutes from the airport to SM City Cebu; traffic varies.
